model.name: ministral-3-14b-bf16
model.about: Mistral AI Ministral 3 14B Instruct (2512) in BF16, as published by Mistral: the same model as ministral-3-14b without FP8, for the A100, which has no FP8 hardware and on whose generation (an A40) the FP8 version failed to compile. Apache-2.0. Same settings as the FP8 profile: vLLM v0.29.0 (v0.30.0 cannot load Mistral 3, vllm-project/vllm#58755), Mistral's own format, reasoning_effort none, temperature 0.05.

answers.sql:
WITH current_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_key,
    customer_segment_code
  FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer
  WHERE
    is_current = TRUE
)
SELECT
  customer_segment_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM
  current_customers
GROUP BY
  customer_segment_code
ORDER BY
  customer_count DESC;

WITH account_transaction_fees AS (
  SELECT
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(fat.fee_amount) AS total_fees
  FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_channel c ON fat.channel_key = c.channel_key
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE
    d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  GROUP BY
    c.display_name
)

SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(total_fees, 0) AS total_fees
FROM
  account_transaction_fees
ORDER BY
  total_fees DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date ON bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily.business_date_key = bank_dwh.dim_date.date_key
WHERE bank_dwh.dim_date.calendar_date = '2025-08-31'
  AND bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily.days_past_due > 90;

WITH atm_transactions_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        ft.branch_key,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM
        bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction ft
    JOIN
        bank_dwh.dim_date d ON ft.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE
        d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    GROUP BY
        ft.branch_key
)

SELECT
    b.region_code,
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COALESCE(atm.transaction_count, 0) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_branch b
LEFT JOIN
    atm_transactions_2025 atm ON b.branch_key = atm.branch_key
WHERE
    b.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY
    b.region_code, b.display_name, atm.transaction_count
ORDER BY
    b.region_code, atm.transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 1 FOR EACH b.region_code;

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    c.currency_code,
    SUM(COALESCE(f.original_amount, 0)) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
  FROM
    bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE
    d.calendar_year_number = 2025
    AND f.event_status_code = 'COMPLETED'  -- Assuming 'COMPLETED' is the status for settled transactions
    AND f.is_returned = FALSE
  GROUP BY
    c.currency_code
)
SELECT
  currency_code,
  total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM
  wire_transfers_2025
ORDER BY
  total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date ON fact_wire_transfer.business_date_key = dim_date.date_key
WHERE dim_date.calendar_year_number = 2025;

WITH employee_salaries AS (
  SELECT
    c.annual_income_amount,
    b.branch_key
  FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer c
  JOIN
    bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON c.residence_country_code = b.country_code
  WHERE
    c.annual_income_amount IS NOT NULL
    AND c.is_active = TRUE
    AND b.is_active = TRUE
    AND c.effective_to_date IS NULL
    AND b.effective_to_date IS NULL
)
SELECT
  b.display_name AS branch_name,
  AVG(es.annual_income_amount) AS average_salary
FROM
  employee_salaries es
JOIN
  bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON es.branch_key = b.branch_key
GROUP BY
  b.display_name
ORDER BY
  average_salary DESC;

WITH duplicates AS (
  SELECT
    customer_key,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT record_hash, ', ' ORDER BY record_hash) AS record_hashes
  FROM
    bank_dwh.dim_customer
  WHERE
    is_current = TRUE
  GROUP BY
    customer_key
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
)

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE
  customer_key IN (
    SELECT customer_key
    FROM duplicates
  )
  AND NOT (
    customer_key IN (
      SELECT customer_key
      FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
      WHERE is_current = TRUE
      AND record_hash IN (
        SELECT UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(record_hashes, ', '))
        FROM duplicates
      )
      ORDER BY version_number DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  );
